partner_result_applied.scope: arbitrary-orientation one-exception exact theorem and 1 percent stability via pair/triple cover

underlying_dependency.scope: definite 2x2 principal-block bound pi/sqrt(det) and nonsingular 3x3 bound (2pi+3sqrt3)/sigma_min, both uniform over affine tilts

mathematical_change.statement: For B=epsilon*lambda*I_4+s vv^T+E with ||E||op<=delta*lambda and every 0<=delta<1/5, independent density<=1 inputs give an affine-quadratic density cap C_delta/lambda with explicit optimized C_delta. Arbitrary matrix completion outside a certified principal block preserves the same cap by conditioning.

unresolved_implication: From only three arbitrary large eigenvalues, prove a quantitative dichotomy yielding either a principal block in the delta<1/5 one-exception basin or a product-preserving aggregate/cross-block estimate. Fixed-size principal-block extraction is false for delocalized rank-three projectors.
next_step: Combine the local stability basin with the diffuse rank-three cross-block partition theorem and search for a concentrated-versus-diffuse frame decomposition that survives arbitrary extra spectral terms.
